operatorApproval.notes:
Two changes, both from the model review of #616 (AUDIT/review-616-opus-20261106.txt) and both verified against the tree before and after.

1. test/integration/worker-stream-truncation.test.ts:306 'worker: resume triggers through the armed resilient stream layer (production path)' asserts isResilientRuntime(executor.getModelRuntime()). PiWorkerExecutor arms the layer through wireResilientModelRuntime with no env of its own, so it reads the ambient process.env; 141ca5db (X06) moved PI_INFERENCE_RESILIENCE_ENABLED to default-off, so the scenario asserted an armed runtime while building an unarmed one. Measured before this commit: 20 pass at X06's parent 009837c3, 19 pass / 1 fail at 141ca5db, 45d42acb, 6818842c and a93b53a0 (X08/logs/19 has the per-tree table). withProbe() now takes { resilience: 'on' } and sets the switch for the one scenario that needs the armed path, restoring the previous environment in the same finally block. 20 pass / 0 fail after (X09/logs/01).
   This is the pattern 259a4233 (#604) already uses for resilient-inference-integration.test.ts:133 and resilient-inference-wiring.test.ts:232. No assertion was changed: the armed-path expectations (streamResumes === 1, resumed history, side effect preserved) are exactly what passed at origin/main while the default was on. The default-off semantics remain asserted in test/unit/resilience-default-off.test.ts (3/3) and the other 19 scenarios in this file keep driving the unarmed default.

2. src/git/GitRepo.ts resolveCommonDir() distinguished ENOENT/ENOTDIR from EACCES/ESTALE/EIO when lstat-ing git's reported path, but called discoverRepo(repoRoot) unguarded: a filesystem error there surfaced bare, losing the fact that git had reported a directory that does not exist. It now throws naming both facts, with `cause`. The 'resolves to nothing usable' branch and its test are untouched (guard unit 5/5, X09/logs/01); the change is error-text only, so no new test was added for it -- the throw it guards requires an injected filesystem failure that this repo's harness has no seam for.

Regression-check set at this commit (X09/logs/01-03): worker-stream-truncation 20/0, git-common-dir-repair 5/5, resilience-default-off 3/3, resilient-inference-integration 10/10, resilient-inference-wiring 7/7, mission-interrupt-pause + mission-merge-queue-flow 18/18 in 49 s, the six git units 5/3/3/11/4/10 pass, typecheck:core exit 0, biome exit 0.

Review findings NOT accepted, with reason (full adjudication in AUDIT/review-616-adjudication-20261106.txt): the pathPolicy case-folding suggestion (case-sensitive git index; folding would cause false rejects on case-sensitive filesystems -- nit, dismissed), and the taskManifest MICROTASK_CEILING note (self-described as theoretical). The review's reference to 'issue #621' is not reproducible from the repository and was not relied upon.
